items.text: Jamshid Barzegar said Donald Trump's support for Benjamin Netanyahu indicates increased coordination between Washington and Tel Aviv to confront the Islamic Republic. He added that the likelihood of new military operations against the Islamic Republic has increased. There is also disagreement in Tehran over negotiation or continued confrontation with the US.

Reza Pahlavi urged American voters to consider candidates' positions on the Iranian people and freedom. He stated that a free Iran benefits both Iranians and the world and called the Islamic Republic the root of the crisis. He emphasized that the only sustainable solution is to remove the regime.

Abbas Kaabi, a member of the Assembly of Experts presidium, stated that revenge against Trump and Netanyahu is certain. He mentioned using the country's capacities and 32 million devoted lives as ways to counter the enemy's breach of commitments. These remarks were made in an interview with Tasnim.

Donald Trump expressed full and unconditional support for Benjamin Netanyahu in the Israeli prime ministerial election. Trump described the Islamic Republic of Iran as a serious threat and warned that if behavior does not change, they will finish the job soon. Netanyahu thanked Trump for his support and said they will complete the mission together.

Mokhtar Al-Boshokeh was transferred from solitary confinement to the general ward in Arak prison but continues his hunger strike and faces health issues. Hamzeh Savari Lofte has also started a hunger strike in support of him and is experiencing low blood pressure. Both political prisoners are held in Arak and Qezelhesar prisons.

An 800-year-old historic plane tree in the village of Zaglik, Ahar County, was cut down. The tree was registered as a national heritage site and was cut for selling wood and funding the construction of a restroom. A legal case has been filed and the loader used has been confiscated.

Workers at Damash mineral water factory reported non-payment of four months of their insurance premiums. Despite deductions from their salaries, insurance services have been cut off for about a month. This has caused difficulties for workers and their families in accessing medical treatment.

Hamidreza Haji Babaei, the deputy speaker of the parliament, spoke about American bombs and Iran's missile program. He said Iran has plans for all types of American bombs. He also stated that if the US brings 'mother bombs,' Iran will respond with 'father missiles.'
